subject.title: feat: show cloud workspace conflicts in the Control UI

question: Should this Control UI phase require final-head production proof from a real Gateway-to-worker workspace conflict before it lands, rather than relying on mocked-Gateway browser coverage?
rationale: The change is an operator recovery surface for production cloud-worker state, and the PR documents that no real worker lease was created during its attempted end-to-end run.

options.title: Require live conflict proof
options.body: Rebase and provide redacted final-head proof of one real conflicted cloud-worker reconciliation flowing through the Gateway and Control UI.

options.title: Accept mock-boundary evidence
options.body: Land with the focused mocked-Gateway browser lifecycle evidence, explicitly accepting that the production worker-to-Gateway-to-UI boundary remains unobserved for this phase.

recommendation.title: Require live conflict proof
recommendation.body: Rebase and provide redacted final-head proof of one real conflicted cloud-worker reconciliation flowing through the Gateway and Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged-history evidence identifies this contributor as the owner of the staged-result and conflict-projection phases that this UI layer consumes.
